rationale: The SC-001 primary case. Declares both non-nullable attributes and format-shaped validation constraints, together with a richer acceptance-scenario set. The migrated implementation is required to make the declared constraints and scenarios observable in the generated source; the pre-migration implementation does not.

whatThePreMigrationStagesHonour: An attribute declared nullable:false causes a not-blank annotation on text attributes and a not-null annotation on non-text attributes. This IS honoured before migration and must not be reported as a missing trace.
whatThePreMigrationStagesIgnore: the declared acceptance scenarios, which have no effect on the generated test class
preMigrationExpectation.therefore: For this blueprint the pre-migration signature is: the non-nullable constraint IS observable as a required-attribute annotation, while every format constraint and every scenario is absent. The verification block recorded by the capture script distinguishes these two cases explicitly rather than claiming that no declared constraint leaves any trace.

userStories.intent: register a new member with a contact email and display name
userStories.benefit: the member can be reached and identified

scenarios.given: a well-formed email address and a non-empty display name
scenarios.then: the member is persisted and returned with its generated identifier

scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the member
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid before reaching the service layer

scenarios.given: an empty or whitespace-only display name
scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the member
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid before reaching the service layer

userStories.intent: record an age and a membership code subject to format rules

scenarios.given: an age below the permitted minimum
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

scenarios.given: a membership code that does not match the permitted pattern
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: retrieve a member that does not exist
userStories.benefit: the caller receives an unambiguous not-found signal

scenarios.given: no member exists with the requested identifier
scenarios.then: the service reports the resource as not found
